rules: One immutable manifest per acquired raw payload and source publication vintage.
Manifest fields must exactly match the observation row; timestamps are compared after UTC normalization.
final_url must be HTTPS and must equal the registered source_url unless explicitly listed in registry.allowed_final_urls.
HTTP status must be 200; byte_length must be positive; retrieved_at must not precede published_at.
The parser recomputes SHA-256 and byte length from the raw payload file and checks path containment.
Never overwrite manifests; corrections require a new manifest ID and append-only evidence.
